description: This file defines functions to generate synthetic property fields and values related to posts in Mattermost, including post ID, preview, channel, team, author, and creation time.

methods.name: getSyntheticPropertyFields
methods.description: Returns a set of synthetic property fields for a given group ID, including post ID, preview, channel, team, author, and creation time.

methods.name: getSyntheticPropertyValues
methods.description: Generates an array of property values for a reported post, including post ID, preview, channel, team, author, and creation time, associated with specific IDs.
